summary: Hide Annual_GWP_Estimate_Year_1_c and POS_FSCS_Exposure on Account (visible to Admins/support only)

description.raw: User Story: As a Product Owner / Security Lead I want the Account fields Annual_GWP_Estimate_Year_1_c and POS_FSCS_Exposure hidden from non-admin users So that sensitive or legacy exposure/GWP fields are not visible to standard users while System Administrators and approved support roles retain visibility for troubleshooting and reporting Description / Scope: Hide the Account fields Annual_GWP_Estimate_Year_1_c and POS_FSCS_Exposure for all non-admin users across the org. This is a visibility change only. Acceptance Criteria (GIVEN / WHEN / THEN): UI visibility (Account detail page) GIVEN a non-admin user WHEN they open any Account in Lightning Experience THEN Annual_GWP_Estimate_Year_1_c and POS_FSCS_Exposure do not appear anywhere on the page  GIVEN a System Administrator or approved support role WHEN they open any Account THEN the two fields remain visible Field-Level Security & permission sets GIVEN org profiles and permission sets WHEN FLS is updated THEN the two fields are hidden (read and edit unchecked) for all non-admin profiles and permission sets and are visible for System Administrator and explicitly approved support roles Search, compact layouts & global search GIVEN a non-admin user performs a search or views compact lists WHEN results or compact/list fields are shown THEN the fields are not displayed or searchable for that user Reports & dashboards GIVEN a non-admin user builds or views reports and dashboards WHEN they try to add or view these fields THEN the fields are not available in the field picker and do not appear in report results for that user; admins retain full access to report on these fields
